deviation: The draft replaces the guaranteed minimum of 10 business days of testing with an open-ended "reasonable period" in which Arcadia must review. This could shorten testing and let the Supplier argue Arcadia is in breach if it reviews slowly. Written acceptance is still required and there is no deemed acceptance, so the core protection holds.
suggested_text: A Deliverable is accepted only when the Customer confirms acceptance in writing after not less than 10 business days of testing. If the Customer notifies the Supplier of any material non-conformity with the agreed specification, the Supplier shall correct it promptly at no additional charge and resubmit the Deliverable, and the testing period shall restart on resubmission. No Deliverable shall be deemed accepted by reason of the passage of time, use, or Customer silence.
